[[File:BloodEatingFungusEGPM.jpg|thumb|right|The effect of blood-eating fungus]]
'''Blood-eating fungus''' was a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Fungus/Legends|fungus]] that lived within the skin of [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]] and ate their [[Blood/Legends|blood]]. [[Mining/Legends|Mine]] [[Miner/Legends|workers]] were often infected with the fungus.
